definitions.explanation: A chair with supports for the arms. A compound of {肘掛|ひじか}け (armrest) and {椅子|いす} (chair).

examples.japanese: {肘掛|ひじか}け{椅子|いす}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{座|すわ}って→座る：00757_suwaru⟧{本|ほん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧。
examples.english: I sit in the armchair and read a book.

examples.japanese: {革張|かわば}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{肘掛|ひじか}け{椅子|いす}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧⟦{居間|いま}→居間：01745_ima⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{肘掛|ひじか}け{椅子|いす}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦うたた{寝|ね}→うたた寝：08036_utatane⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦していた→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: My grandfather always used to doze off in the armchair in the living room.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{肘掛|ひじか}け→肘掛け：18182_hijikake⟧ (armrest) + ⟦{椅子|いす}→椅子：00706_isu⟧ (chair). The native Japanese term for armchair, more commonly used than the loanword アームチェア.

FORMS:
⟦{肘|ひじ}→肘：00938_hiji⟧ (elbow) + {掛|か}け (from {掛|か}ける, to rest on) = armrest
The same {掛|か}け pattern appears in ⟦{腰掛|こしか}け→腰掛け：15323_koshikake⟧ (seat/bench, lit. "hip rest").

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {肘掛|ひじか}け{椅子|いす}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{座|すわ}る→座る：00757_suwaru⟧: to sit in an armchair
- {肘掛|ひじか}け{椅子|いす}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦くつろぐ→くつろぐ：02576_kutsurogu⟧: to relax in an armchair
- {革張|かわば}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{肘掛|ひじか}け{椅子|いす}: leather armchair

RELATED CHAIR TYPES:
- ⟦{回転|かいてん}→回転：00141_kaiten⟧⟦{椅子|いす}→椅子：00706_isu⟧: swivel chair
- {折|お}りたたみ⟦{椅子|いす}→椅子：00706_isu⟧: folding chair
- ⟦ソファー→ソファー：05607_sofaa⟧: sofa
